changelog:
- Initial release of seekit-search skill.
- Enables agents to perform live web, video, and social searches with no API key required.
- Supports multiple providers (web, video, social) and structured JSON output.
- CLI interface preferred; Python API also supported.
- Includes guidance on choosing providers and consuming search results.
